title: Qatar: outdoor-work heat rule
text: Qatar Ministerial Decision No. 17 of 2021 is the rule Harara is built around and validates against. In summer, outdoor work is prohibited during the fixed midday window of 10:00 to 15:30, and work must stop at any time the measured WBGT reaches 32.1 degrees Celsius. The seasonal window runs from 1 June to 15 September. Harara treats 32.1 as a hard limit and never plans work above it, and it treats the midday window as the enforceable baseline it works within.
source: State of Qatar, Ministerial Decision No. 17 of 2021 on measures to protect workers from heat stress (rule store: qatar-md-17-2021)
